# GOAT Handyman & Remodeling

> GOAT Handyman & Remodeling is a handyman and remodeling company serving Nassau & Suffolk Counties, Long Island, NY. Phone: (516) 447-4976. Office: 64 Hilton Ave, Hempstead, NY 11550. Hours: Sunday–Friday 8am–6pm, closed Saturday. Request service: https://www.goathandymanremodeling.com/request-service.html

GOAT Handyman & Remodeling provides professional handyman, home repair, and remodeling services across Long Island, New York. The site lists 13 services and 25 service-area towns in Nassau County. All services are performed by licensed and insured professionals; free estimates are available by phone or through the request-service form.

## Services

- [Handyman Services](https://www.goathandymanremodeling.com/services/handyman-services/): General handyman work, repairs, and home maintenance.
- [Home Repair Services](https://www.goathandymanremodeling.com/services/home-repair/): Repairs for common household problems.
- [Drywall Repair](https://www.goathandymanremodeling.com/services/drywall-repair/): Drywall patching, repair, and finishing.
- [Carpentry](https://www.goathandymanremodeling.com/services/carpentry/): Custom carpentry and woodwork.
- [Door Repair](https://www.goathandymanremodeling.com/services/door-repair/): Door installation and repair.
- [Window Repair](https://www.goathandymanremodeling.com/services/window-repair/): Window repair and replacement.
- [Flooring](https://www.goathandymanremodeling.com/services/flooring/): Flooring installation and repair.
- [Deck Repair](https://www.goathandymanremodeling.com/services/deck-repair/): Deck repair and restoration.
- [Bathroom Remodeling](https://www.goathandymanremodeling.com/services/bathroom-remodeling/): Bathroom renovation and remodeling.
- [Kitchen Remodeling](https://www.goathandymanremodeling.com/services/kitchen-remodeling/): Kitchen renovation and remodeling.
- [Siding](https://www.goathandymanremodeling.com/services/siding/): Siding installation and repair.
- [Insulation](https://www.goathandymanremodeling.com/services/insulation/): Home insulation services.
- [Plumbing & Electrical](https://www.goathandymanremodeling.com/services/plumbing-electrical/): Plumbing and electrical repairs.
- [All Services](https://www.goathandymanremodeling.com/services/): Full list of services offered.
